parameters.name: DstIP
parameters.description:
The legacy destination IP parameter.

> The POP gateway passes this parameter through, but the backend of this operation does not read it. Specifying this parameter has no filtering effect. To filter by IP address, use PublicIP or PrivateIP. If only DstIP is specified, the operation returns MissingParameter.IpFilter (-340415) because no valid IP filtering parameter is provided.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds.

parameters.name: IsAITraffic
parameters.description: Specifies whether to collect statistics only on traffic that accesses AI services. Default value: false.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description: The language type of the received message.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: PrivateIP
parameters.description:
The private IP address.
> At least one of PublicIP and PrivateIP must be specified.

parameters.name: PublicIP
parameters.description:
The public IP address.
> At least one of PublicIP and PrivateIP must be specified.

parameters.name: SecuritySuggest
parameters.description: The security policy for the Outbound Domain.

parameters.name: Sort
parameters.description: The field by which to sort the results.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The IP address of the access source. **[Deprecated]**

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds.
